newPlatforms.notes: Passively verified on 2026-07-19 from Get Known Radio's official submission guide, terms, privacy, about, home and editorial pages. The canonical form accepts one MP3 at 320kbps minimum or WAV, a short record note, genre tag, contact email and a checkbox confirming the right to license the track for broadcast. The FAQ expressly accepts non-US artists and both released and unreleased music. The terms grant a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, display, broadcast, stream, promote, distribute and reproduce submitted content across the website, live stream, social media, newsletter and marketing materials, without compensation unless separately agreed. The privacy policy identifies Google reCAPTCHA Enterprise, public display of accepted track metadata, international processing and typical retention of submission records for the rotation period plus about two years. The official guide provides an email fallback when the form is inaccessible or upload size is problematic, but the address is protected in passive search results and was not decoded. Activity is exceptionally current: the official home page is dated July 18, 2026, carries a live 24/7 stream and recently submitted tracks, while the editorial page contains posts through July 17, 2026. No form field, CAPTCHA, file, email or submission was used.

newPlatforms.notes: Passively verified on 2026-07-19 from All'it Radio's official home, schedule and privacy pages. The station accepts Hip-Hop, R&B, Reggae and Urban music through a linked Google Form only; email submissions are not considered. The route asks for one latest or strongest track as a downloadable high-quality MP3 or WAV at 44.1kHz/16-bit stereo and requires cover art. The page explicitly says a Gmail account is required. If selected, the track enters the 'All It or Not at All' voting page for one week; 100 positive votes are required for regular rotation, and the artist must follow the station on Instagram or Facebook. Submission authorizes broadcast if selected. info@allitradio.com is a first-party domain-aligned general contact; hitus@allitradio.com is first-party published in the privacy policy. Neither was substituted for the form. Activity is supported by a live current-track area, 24/7-broadcast positioning and a current weekly schedule including Friday and Saturday shows. The external Google Form could not be passively loaded, so live fields, upload limits, consent, CAPTCHA and storage controls remain unresolved. No login, form field, follow, vote, file, cover art or submission was used.

newPlatforms.notes: Passively verified on 2026-07-19 from Indie Global 365's official music-submission, home, artist-membership and legacy about pages. The current canonical page says the first-party form is the only route and accepts up to two Hip-Hop, R&B or Caribbean Reggae/Soca songs. Music must be positive, uplifting, motivational, conscious or feel-good; MP3 files should be 192kbps, no more than 10MB each and named with artist and title. The visible form asks for artist name, email, song titles, up to two songs and one image per song, shows a 25MB aggregate upload limit and requires acceptance of Terms & Conditions. The separate membership page confirms the free submission tier and lists optional paid community plans. A legacy first-party page still says submissions are by indieglobal365@gmail.com, creating a route conflict; the current form was retained as canonical and the email was stored only as historical context. Activity is supported by a live-radio/current-song area, an active music catalog and current open submission and membership pages. The linked Terms & Conditions page could not be passively fetched, so licence, retention and indemnity wording remain unresolved. No form field, upload, terms checkbox, email, membership or payment was used.
